user.title: Qrio account
user.description: Sign in with your Qrio account. Your password is used once to mint a local key, then discarded — lock/unlock runs entirely over Bluetooth with no cloud. You'll pick which lock to add next.

select_lock.title: Choose a lock
select_lock.description: Select the lock to add. Run the integration again to add another.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-mint Qrio key
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the password for {email} to mint a fresh key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Qrio service.
error.lock_gone: That lock is no longer on this account.

abort.already_configured: This lock is already set up.
abort.all_configured: Every lock on this account is already set up.
